kjv: Without me they shall bow down
note: Hebrew bilti kara' is "nothing but crouching"; the KJV reads bilti as "without (me)", supplying God as speaker.

kjv: the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing
mine: the yoke will be broken because of the fatness
note: Hebrew mippene-shamen "because of oil/fat" is obscure (perhaps the neck grown too fat for the yoke, or a corrupt text); "anointing" is an interpretation that has become a popular slogan.
